Description:
Years of dedicated study have yielded results, though the scholarship of the dark arts is not akin to the arcane. Standing before you is a woman who does not manipulate the strings of magic - no, she destroys them, weaving a tunnel of sorts to an unfathomable source of eldrich energy that pulses ominously around her, stirring unease into your soul. Out of nowhere, she laughs, and her features soften into a kind smile directed at you. Despite society's rejection, she is no monster. She, too, is human, with emotions and heart, however dark it may be.
Warlocks are practicioners of the occult or outer magic and techniques beyond the normal domain. Using a blade, fell magic and even stealing powers away from the enemies, each warlock has its own source for their powers, by study, persuasiveness or pure chance.
A warlock is a spellcaster attuned to the unknown and bizarre, who only needs to rest inbetween fights, and every encounter wakes the power in them anew - this time, sleep is not for the wicked.
Quick Note: A warlock is a spellcaster attuned to the unknown and bizarre, who only needs to rest inbetween fights, and every encounter wakes the power in them anew - this time, sleep is not for the wicked.

Spellcasting.Text:
Mana is a resource you can spend to cast Abilities. Some Abilities have a Mana cost, some don't.
Unlike other Mana-based classes, your Mana instantly regenerates 10 minutes after finishing every combat encounter (if you don't enter another combat meanwhile).
If you want to use Mana inbetween encounters, you spend Mana normally and, as specified, it replenishes 10 minutes after the next combat encounter.

Mana.Regain: Your Mana reset after every combat.

Spellcasting.Change: You can change your known Spells and Talents inbetween Adventures.
Spellcasting.Other: All Warlock-specific Abilities are considered Spells.

Combat Extras: Max Mana is 2 and replenishes after Combats
~Affiance Casting~.Effect:
Your Max {Mana}Mana is 2. It never increases and can't increase except through Warlock Talents.
Your {Mana}Mana replenishes after each Worthy Combat.
~Affiance Casting~.Name: ~Affiance Casting~

~Evoke~.Effect:
You start each Worthy Combat with 0 Evoke Points.
When you roll at least 1 maximum die on any Act, gain 1 Evoke Point.
Some Spells can consume all Evoke Points to gain an improved effect ^for each Evoke Point spent^.

You may pick 2 Evocations.
~Evoke~.Notes: You must spend ^all^ EP when you decide to. You can change your Evocations inbetween Adventures.
~Evoke~.Name: ~Evoke~

Combat Extras: You have a Flux Damage Type
~Flux~.Effect: Choose a Damage Type from the ones listed below. That becomes your {Color('magenta' 'Flux')} Type. Some of your Spells's Damage deal that Damage Type (written explicitly on those Spells).
~Flux~.Upgrade:
1. Fire, 2. Cold, 3. Shock, 4. Pulse, 5. Poison, 6. Acid, 7. Divine, 8. Scourge.
You can change your Flux inbetween Adventures.
~Flux~.Name: ~Flux~

Starting Abilities Description.Spending Evoke Points:
Note that many of your Spells gain an improved effect when you spend Evoke Points on them, though your Evocations cost 0 Action Points.
For example, Diverge and Soul Drain both consume Evoke Points, so you can either spend the Evoke Points on Diverge, then cast Soul Drain to hit multiple targets, hoping to get more Max Health or Healing, or you could cast Soul Drain with Evoke Points to make sure you execute the targets!

Starting Abilities Description.Affiance Casting:
Don't forget to spend Mana every Combat! You can't keep Mana from Combat to Combat, so spend it all!
If you want to spend Mana before a Combat, you will remain with that much Mana in the next Combat.

~Transfusion~.Effect: Give all your {Mana}Mana to an ally.
~Transfusion~.Name: ~Transfusion~

Other Abilities Description: You have access to an extra tier of Talents at Level 1 called Evocation Talents. You get one for free, and can get more as if you're getting regular Talents.

~Diverge~.Effect: {Evoke}: Your next Act that targets Unit(s) targets an extra Unit in range per Evoke Point spent, but deals -50% Damage (or Healing if it heals) to the secondary targets.
~Diverge~.Name: ~Diverge~

~Overwhelm~.Effect: {Evoke}: Your next offensive Act also Single-Stuns one of the Units hit, for each extra Evoke Point spent
~Overwhelm~.Notes:
You can Single-Stun the same Unit, or a different Unit hit. When increasing the Stun Degree inflicted with an Evoke Point, only increase it for one of the hit Units.
A Single-Stunned Unit has -1 Action Point on its (next) Turn.
~Overwhelm~.Name: ~Overwhelm~

~Amplify~.Effect: {Evoke}: Your next Ability or Attack has its ^Dice Upgraded^ to the next die type per Evoke Point spent.
~Amplify~.Notes: Having Dice Upgraded means, for example, d6's become d8's, or d10's become d12's. D12's and d20's just gain +1.
~Amplify~.Name: ~Amplify~

~Obliterate~.Effect: {Evoke}: Your next Act that targets Unit(s) deals +1d6 Damage on cast, or +1d4 Healing to the target on cast, per Evoke Point spent.
~Obliterate~.Upgrade: These extra dice can not produce more Evoke Points.
~Obliterate~.Notes: If it heals, it does extra Healing. If it deals Damage, it deals extra Damage. If used with Damage over time effects, the extra Damage only happens when you cast the Spell.
~Obliterate~.Name: ~Obliterate~

~Transpose~.Effect: {Evoke}: Teleport up to 4 meters away per Evoke Point spent.
~Transpose~.Name: ~Transpose~

~Summon Familiar~.Effect:
You have a familiar, shaped directly by your {Color('magenta' 'Flux')} (a small demon, a spirit, etc).
The familiar follows you, has its own personality, and casts ^Eerie Bolt^ automatically if you have Evoke Points.
While with you in Combat, it can't take Damage unless purposefully targeted.
~Summon Familiar~.Upgrade:
It has a number of Skill Points equal to your Level.
It may or may not follow your commands, depending on your relationship.
If it dies or runs away, you can spend 10 minutes to resummon it.
~Summon Familiar~.Notes:
Work with your Quest Master to determine your familiar's look and personality. You may need to work to convince it to do things for you.
The familiar doesn't obey normal Combat rules, and doesn't use Movement or {A}Action Points.

Eerie Bolt.Effect:
Cast automatically and for free, on the same target, after the Warlock targets a Unit within 3 meters.
Can generate an Evoke Point!

~Summon Familiar~.Name: ~Summon Familiar~

~Curse of the Mind~.Duration: Minor curse lasts until end of Adventure
~Curse of the Mind~.Effect:
Choose a Unit. Deal 6d4 Psychic Damage to it and it becomes Single-Stunned.
Apply a ~Combo~ to it.
~Curse of the Mind~.Upgrade: Alternatively, affect it bywith minor curse effects (e.g. is clumsy, stumbles, get pimples, etc), getting -2 on all Checks.
~Curse of the Mind~.Notes:
Be creative with the effects of the minor curse effects!

A Single-Stunned Unit has -1 Action Point on its (next) Turn.
~Curse of the Mind~.Name: ~Curse of the Mind~

~Wyrd Suture~.Effect:
Roll 1d12 - 4. Then choose a Unit.
If it's negative, deal Scourge Damage to it. Otherwise, Heal it.

{Evoke}: +100% Damage or Healing per Evoke Point spent.
~Wyrd Suture~.Name: ~Wyrd Suture~

~Oculus~.Effect:
You conjure a magical eye that stays in place and records everything it sees. You can physically retrieve it to see everything it recorded, as if looking through a crystal ball.

You can program it to respond to a certain trigger to cause it to explode, dealing 2d6 {Color('magenta' 'Flux')} to all Units within 1 meter of it.
~Oculus~.Notes: The eye may fit inside your palm, or may be slightly larger. It is visible, but you can freely decide how how it is textured.
~Oculus~.Name: ~Oculus~

~Thaumaturgy~.Effect:
You create one of the following magical effects:
{Diamond} Your voice booms up to three times as loud as normal for 1 minute.
{Diamond} You cause flames to flicker, brighten, dim, or change color for 1 minute.
{Diamond} You cause harmless tremors in the ground for 1 minute.
{Diamond} You cause an unlocked door or window to fly open or slam shut.
{Diamond} You alter the appearance of your eyes for 1 minute.
~Thaumaturgy~.Upgrade: At Level 4 you can cast this for 1 {A}Action Point, and at Level 7, for 0 {A}Action Points.
~Thaumaturgy~.Name: ~Thaumaturgy~

~Hail~.Effect:
Choose a target and a Stat.
Blast it for 2d8 + ^its Stat^ {Color('magenta' 'Flux')} Damage.
~Hail~.Combo: Damages an extra Unit in range with -50% of the original Damage.
~Hail~.Notes: Each extra Unit hit must be different than the others.
~Hail~.Name: ~Hail~

~Deathfire Wave~.Effect:
Shoot a bolt of deathly fire in a 1x10 meter line. All Units it touches take 1d4 + 1d6 + 1d8 Scourge or Fire Damage (your choice).

{Evoke}: When it hits a wall or the range ends, the bolt continues at an angle you choose for another 1x10 meters. This happens per Evoke Point spent.
~Deathfire Wave~.Notes: The bolt can't hit the same Unit twice. The bolt travels as if you're drawing multiple lines with the same stroke. For example, if you spend 2 Evoke Points, there will be 3 lines.
~Deathfire Wave~.Name: ~Deathfire Wave~

~Curse of Pain~.Effect: Choose a Unit. At the start of each of your Turns, it takes 1d4 Scourge Damage.
~Curse of Pain~.Name: ~Curse of Pain~

~Witherwave~.Effect:
Your next {Type} weapon attack deals +50% Damage and applies a ~Combo~.

{Variants}
~Witherwave~.Name: ~Witherwave~

~Soul Drain~.Effect:
Deal 2d6 True Damage to 2 Units.
For each killed, Heal for 4 Health or gain +1 Max Health permanently (your choice).

{Evoke}: Executes non-Epic Units at or below 10% of its Max Health per Evoke Point spent.
~Soul Drain~.Notes:
For example, if you spend 2 Evoke Points, this executes Units at or below 20% Health. If you spend 3 Evoke Points, this executes Units at or below 30% Health. And so on.
Both Units take Damage from the same roll.
~Soul Drain~.Name: ~Soul Drain~

~Veinlight~.Effect:
Choose a 3x3 meter area.
All Enemies in the area take 2d6 + 2d8 {Color('magenta' 'Flux')} Damage.

{Evoke}: Increase the area by 3 meters in both directions per Evoke Point spent.
~Veinlight~.Notes: For example, for 1 Evoke Point spent the area becomes 6x6 meters. For 2, it becomes 9x9 meters. And so on.
~Veinlight~.Name: ~Veinlight~

~Curse of Weakness~.Effect: Choose a Unit. The first time it deals Damage on its every Turn, roll 1d4 and subtract it from its dealt Damage.
~Curse of Weakness~.Name: ~Curse of Weakness~

~Curse of Lethargy~.Effect: Choose a Unit. At the start of each of its Turns, it is Slowed.
~Curse of Lethargy~.Name: ~Curse of Lethargy~
~Curse of Lethargy~.Notes: A Slowed Unit has -50% Movement Speed until its next Movement.

~Fundamentals I~.Effect: Pick one more Level 1 Class or Utility Talent.
~Fundamentals I~.Name: ~Fundamentals I~

~Life Sap~.Effect: You can cast Abilties that cost {Mana}Mana by spending 2d6 {Health}Health per 1 {Mana}Mana instead.
~Life Sap~.Upgrade: If you would go Down this way, you still cast the Spell, and go Down immediately after.
~Life Sap~.Name: ~Life Sap~

~Mind Over Matter~.Effect:
You can choose how many Evoke Points you want to spend when spending them.
At any time, you can spend 1 {Mana}Mana to gain 2 Evoke Points.
~Mind Over Matter~.Name: ~Mind Over Matter~

Combat Extras: You have extra Magic Font Spells
~Font Magic~.Effect:
You may select a `Magic Font$/Other/MagicFonts` to pick Spells from.
You get a number of them equal to your Focus.
~Font Magic~.Notes: All Magic Font Spells act like Class Talents. Notes: You can change your Font and Spells inbetween Adventures.
~Font Magic~.Name: ~Font Magic~

~Invoke Kindred~.Effect:
Invoke 3 _Kindred Beings_, each within 10 meters of you. These are creatures themed and shaped to your {Color('magenta' 'Flux')}, which will do your bidding before returning to their original world.

{Evoke}: +1 summon per Evoke Point spent.

Monster.Name: Kindred Being
Monster.Description: Has a 1 Action Point. Takes its Turn at the end of your Turn.

~Attack~.Effect: Deal 1d6 {Color('magenta' 'Flux')} Damage, or use an Item or Default Ability.

~Invoke Kindred~.Name: ~Invoke Kindred~

~Curse of Frailty~.Effect:
A Unit you can see becomes special-Frail: it takes +50% Damage the next time it takes Damage from an ally.

{Evoke}: +50% extra Damage per Evoke Point spent.
~Curse of Frailty~.Name: ~Curse of Frailty~
~Curse of Frailty~.Notes: A Frail Unit takes +50% Damage the next time it does.

~Gateway~.Duration: Lasts until end of Combat, or 10 real minutes
~Gateway~.Effect:
Open a _gateway_, and another paired one in a location you can see.
Units and projectiles can go through a gateway and appear through the other.

You can cast this with 0 {A}Action Points and no Cooldown by spending 1 {Mana}Mana.
~Gateway~.Upgrade: The gateway does not have a direction - projectiles going one way come out the same way. Units have Line of Sight through the gates, and their Range counts as if the two gates are connected (obviously).
~Gateway~.Name: ~Gateway~

~Curse of the Plague~.Effect:
Choose a Unit and roll 5d6 to see its _death threshold_.
When it gets to that amount or less Health, you can use a free Reaction to kill it.
Then the curse spreads with the same _death threshold_ to all Units within 2 meters of it.
~Curse of the Plague~.Upgrade: Wherever the plague goes, it kills small plants, insects, and rots wood and rusts metal. It also makes fertile soil infertile, turns textile and paper materials into dust, and decays food and poisons water.
~Curse of the Plague~.Notes: The death threshold can stack from multiple Curses of the Plague! Ask the Quest Master whether a Unit should die from the curse.
~Curse of the Plague~.Name: ~Curse of the Plague~

~Torrent~.Effect:
Choose a Unit. Deal 1d4 {Color('magenta' 'Flux')} Damage or apply a ~Combo~ to it.

Then do it again for each Evoke Point you have.
~Torrent~.Name: ~Torrent~

~Overloading Evocation~.Effect: Cast 2 Evocation Talents you Know, combined, with the same Evoke Points applied to both.
~Overloading Evocation~.Name: ~Overloading Evocation~

<Blood Pact>.Effect: This turn, you deal +50% Damage to other Units. Every time you deal 10 or more Damage in one instance, take 5 Psychic Damage.
<Blood Pact>.Name: <Blood Pact>

<Higher Evoke>.Effect: You start each Combat with +1 Evoke Point.
<Higher Evoke>.Name: <Higher Evoke>

~As Fate Willt~.Effect: Gain 2 Evoke Points, then cast a random Evocation spending all your Evoke Points.
~As Fate Willt~.Notes: You can roll 1d6 and reroll on 6.
~As Fate Willt~.Name: ~As Fate Willt~

~Master of Curses~.Effect: Your Curses that are empowered by at least 1 Evoke Point cast as if empowered by +1 Evoke Point.
~Master of Curses~.Name: ~Master of Curses~

~Aura of Ruin~.Requirement: Only usable the moment Combat starts
~Aura of Ruin~.Effect: Reduce the Max Health of all enemies by 10%.
~Aura of Ruin~.Name: ~Aura of Ruin~

~Evoke Entropy~.Effect:
You start each Worthy Combat with 0 Evoke Points.
When you roll at least 1 ~minimum or~ maximum die on any Act, gain 1 Evoke Point.
Some Spells can consume all Evoke Points to gain an improved effect ^for each Evoke Point spent^.

Additionally, you have an extra Talent tier for special Evocations.
~Evoke Entropy~.Notes: You must spend ^all^ EP when you decide to. You can pick one for free Evocation at Level 1, and get more like you would normally get extra Class Talents (e.g. with the extra Known Talents from Intelligence, if above 0).
~Evoke Entropy~.Name: ~Evoke Entropy~

~Consumption~.Effect:
Consume one of your known Abilities until the end of the Adventure to gain 1 Evoke Point.
You can't cast it until the end of the Adventure.
~Consumption~.Name: ~Consumption~

~Inward Invocation~.Effect: Use when ^you^ take minimum or maximum Damage from a dice attack. Gain 1 Evoke Point.
~Inward Invocation~.Name: ~Inward Invocation~

~Borrowed Power~.Effect:
You each Adventure with 2 Evoke Points.
You age 12 times as rapidly.
~Borrowed Power~.Name: ~Borrowed Power~

~Blood Dividend~.Range: 5 meters from you to healed Unit
~Blood Dividend~.Effect:
Your next weapon attack or Spell deals -50% Damage, but heals another Unit for the Damage dealt.
Then it applies a ~Combo~ to one of them.
~Blood Dividend~.Name: ~Blood Dividend~

~Contract of Hunger~.Effect:
At the start of each Combat, get a random _Contract_. While active, you gain a buff. When broken, you suffer a punishment and the _Contract_ ends this Combat.

{Purple(Payout)}: Gain 1 Evoke Point each Turn
{Red(Punishment)}: Become Exhausted
SingleTable: 1. You shall choose a Warlock Ability and cast it every Turn!
2. You shall always target the alive Unit ^you^ have Damaged the most (choose if tied)!
3. You shall never end your Turn without having spent Mana or Evoke Points!
~Contract of Hunger~.Notes:
You always know which Unit you have Damaged the most.
An Exhausted* Unit has -1 Action Point for each tier of Exhaustion. At Triple-Exhausted, the Unit dies.
~Contract of Hunger~.Name: ~Contract of Hunger~

~Contract of Obsidian~.Effect:
At the start of each Combat, get a random _Contract_. While active, you gain a buff. When broken, you suffer a punishment and the _Contract_ ends this Combat.

{Purple(Payout)}: You have doubled Range and gain double the Evoke Points from Evoke.
{Red(Punishment)}: Become Exhausted
SingleTable: 2. You shall never roll minimum on on all dice per Act!
3. You shall always end Turns at least 5 meters away from where you started!
~Contract of Obsidian~.Name: ~Contract of Obsidian~
~Contract of Obsidian~.Notes: An Exhausted* Unit has -1 Action Point for each tier of Exhaustion. At Triple-Exhausted, the Unit dies.

~Contract of Sacrifice~.Effect:
At the start of each Combat, get a random _Contract_. While active, you gain a buff. When broken, you suffer a punishment and the _Contract_ ends this Combat.

{Purple(Payout)}: You start with +1 {Mana}Mana and +1 Evoke Point.
{Red(Punishment)}: Take 2d8 Damage.
SingleTable: 1. You shall take at least 3d8 Damage this Combat!
2. You shall never target a Unit you've already targeted with an attack or Ability this Combat!
3. You shall never use the same attack or Ability a second time this Combat!
~Contract of Sacrifice~.Name: ~Contract of Sacrifice~

~Tome of Evocations~.Effect: You have a special Tome that contains all Evocations and Warlock Talents that have an {Evoke} effect. While carrying the Tome, you know all of them.
~Tome of Evocations~.Notes: Requires spending 1 day and 100 {Gold}Gold to write the Tome, as dictated to you by a higher power.
~Tome of Evocations~.Name: ~Tome of Evocations~

~Congregation of Power~.Effect: +1 Spellpower for each Evoke Point you have.
~Congregation of Power~.Upgrade: Note that Evocations and other Abilities spend the Evoke Points immediately when cast (e.g. Diverge followed by Hail won't benefit from the extra Damage). However, Abilities that themselves consume Evoke Points do benefit from the extra Damage when cast with Evoke Points, like Deathfire Wave or Soul Drain.
~Congregation of Power~.Name: ~Congregation of Power~

~Reabsorption~.Effect: After you use an Ability empowered by at least 2 Evoke Points (from Evocations or itself), gain 1 Evoke Point.
~Reabsorption~.Name: ~Reabsorption~

~Forebearer's Magic~.Effect: You start each Adventure 2 extra {Mana}Mana that doesn't regenerate or disappear after Combats.
~Forebearer's Magic~.Name: ~Forebearer's Magic~

~Hemomancy~.Effect: Whenever you take Damage on your Turn, gain 1 Evoke Point.
~Hemomancy~.Name: ~Hemomancy~

Extras: You may have any number of Contracts
~More Contracts~.Effect: You may select as many Level 7 Talents as you like. All apply.
~More Contracts~.Name: ~More Contracts~

<Final Word>.Effect: When you have exactly 1 {Mana}Mana, and you cast a Spell that cost 1 {Mana}Mana, that Spell casts twice (for free).
<Final Word>.Notes: This is akin to casting the Spell again for 0 {A}Action Points without spending {Mana}Mana (not necessarily on the same target).
<Final Word>.Name: <Final Word>

~Improved Evocations~.Effect: You can always cast 2 Evocations simultaneously, using the same Evoke Points.
~Improved Evocations~.Name: ~Improved Evocations~

~Finger of Obliteration~.Effect:
Deal 12d12 {Color('magenta' 'Flux')} Damage to a Unit you can see.
If it dies, regain 1 {Mana}Mana and its corpse disintegrates.
~Finger of Obliteration~.Name: ~Finger of Obliteration~

<Invoke Old God>.Effect:
You bring forth into the mortal realm a manifestation of your source of power - an old god from the `Pets and Animals page$/Other/PetsAndAnimals`.
You do not control it - it has its own Turn in combat with a Setback of 1d4 and possesses its own will. What will you compromise to forcefully drag an unknowable entity into the mortal plane?
Also, passively, you gain +2 Focus and Presence, and you automatically pass all Impossible Focus Checks (requiring at least 25).
<Invoke Old God>.Downside: This is your Heroic Class Ability and, after getting this Talent, you can no longer change your Talents inbetween Adventures.
<Invoke Old God>.Name: <Invoke Old God>

<The Dark Ritual>.Effect:
Spend any amount of {Mana}Mana. Your next Spell has +50% Damage, Heal, area diameter and range for each {Mana}Mana spent.
After that, restore all your {Mana}Mana.
<The Dark Ritual>.Downside: This is your Heroic Class Ability and, after getting this Talent, you can no longer change your Talents inbetween Adventures.
<The Dark Ritual>.Name: <The Dark Ritual>
